title: Local subspace encoding for spectral prediction: from TabPFN to operator-adaptive calibration
abstract: arXiv:2611.31245v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: TabPFN has already shown useful predictive performance on near-infrared spectra. RamanPFN subsequently proposed two spectral representations for tabular inference: Global Compositional Unmixing (GCU) and Local Vibrational Subspace Encoding (LVSE). We assess whether these representations also help on datasets assembled through the nirs4all ecosystem, and whether their value extends to classical calibration. We reanalyse completed experiments from a public spectral dataset catalogue. On a post-hoc subset of 61 matched numerical prediction tasks, after excluding ten class-code, metadata or semantically ambiguous targets, LVSE reduces RMSE relative to raw-spectrum TabPFN by 10.22%, 12.80% and 14.52% on average for checkpoints 2.5, 3 and 3.5, respectively, with median reductions of 4.99%, 4.74% and 7.82%. translated_title: 用于光谱预测的局部子空间编码：从TabPFN到算子自适应定标
translated_abstract: TabPFN已经在近红外光谱上展现出了有用的预测性能。随后，RamanPFN提出了两种用于表格推理的光谱表示方法：全局成分解混和局部振动子空间编码。我们评估了这些表示方法是否也能在使用nirs4all生态系统构建的数据集上发挥作用，以及它们的价值是否能延伸到经典定标方法。我们重新分析了来自公共光谱数据集目录的已完成实验。在61个匹配的数值预测任务的事后子集上（剔除了十个类别代码、元数据或语义模糊的目标变量后），LVSE相对于原始光谱TabPFN，在检查点2.5、3和3.5处平均分别将RMSE降低了10.22%、12.80%和14.52%，中位数降幅分别为4.99%、4.74%和7.82%。在76个分类数据集上，加权F1分别提高了2.22、2.56和3.81个百分点。（注：原摘要似乎在末尾被截断）
tldr: 该研究证实局部振动子空间编码（LVSE）表示方法在nirs4all生态系统的光谱数据集上能显著降低TabPFN的RMSE并提升分类加权F1，且其价值可扩展至经典定标方法。
en_tdlr: This study demonstrates that Local Vibrational Subspace Encoding (LVSE) representations significantly reduce RMSE and improve weighted F1 for TabPFN-based spectral prediction on nirs4all datasets, with benefits extending to classical calibration methods.
